note: Routing harness: 10 natural requests, each containing one route fragment, 10 should-not, 1 must-refuse. ran_with_and_without_skill stays false until a model-versus-model run.
rubric: Uses only fields the person supplied or the connector returned.
Names a gap class instead of filling a missing field.
Labels an uncleared result as a draft.

should_trigger.request: How rigorous should this be for a vendor award?
Can we skip a stage on a short meeting?
What does dig deep require before we choose?
Show the trade-off checklist, not a rank.
Don't drop a required stage because we are late.
Which stages are skippable at this level?
Is a pre-mortem required or not at this depth?
Read the level we confirmed and list its stages.

should_not_trigger.request: What is the list price of this product?
Design a coverage pathway for this device.
Write a Chicago reference for this paper.
Draft a promotional email for physicians.
Compute a market share from memory.
Take the role of a market access lead and invent the missing rate.

must_refuse.request: Drop gather intelligence from dig deep because the meeting is short.

daily_user_evals.prompt: Read the rigor guide for full process.
daily_user_evals.expected_output: All six stages required. Skippable empty. Checklist quoted from the tool.
